principles: Integrate one bounded capability at a time.
Preserve existing production contracts, guards, canon, FX system, and branch model.
Every step must be independently testable.
Full productions are not required for routine verification.
Large models are optional reasoning providers, not production authority.

target_architecture.boot: AIVideoEdit bootstrap plus portable session state
target_architecture.embedded_inference: ONNX and existing deterministic DSP workers
target_architecture.execution: Existing AIVideoEdit Tool API, guards, FX, proofs, assembly and QC

runtime_rules: Main remains the production authority by default.
MainV2 authority must be selected explicitly during experimental validation.
ONNX evidence cannot bypass production guards.
Jev output is bounded to PASS, FAIL, RETRY, CONTINUE, ESCALATE.
Harness specialist output is advisory only.
Large model binaries are not committed to normal git history.
No automatic full-production regression is required for routine changes.

micro_tests: boot capsule attestation and tamper rejection
model fallback and unknown model rejection
verification.full_production: Reserved for explicit integration checkpoint before promotion to main.

promotion_rule: Do not promote MainV2 to main until boot integration and one checkpoint end-to-end production are explicitly approved.
